# AgentLock: AI Agent Vulnerability Scanner & Automated Red Teaming Platform

> AgentLock is an enterprise automated red-teaming platform that evaluates autonomous AI agents, tool-augmented LLMs, and multi-agent workflows against production security threats before deployment.

## Core Capabilities
- Automated Red Teaming: Penetration testing suites tailored specifically for LLM and AI agent runtime architectures.
- Prompt Injection Testing: Direct and indirect instruction override evaluation, jailbreak delimiter bypass tests, and multi-turn persona hijacking.
- Data Leakage Detection: System prompt extraction probes, API credential discovery tests, sensitive file exfiltration, and PII leakage verification.
- Tool Abuse & Privilege Escalation: Parameter tampering evaluations, unauthorized function invocation checks, and command execution boundaries.
- Memory Poisoning: Long-term memory contamination, session context manipulation, and cross-session knowledge poisoning.
- Cryptographically Verifiable Audit Reports: Tamper-evident scan dossiers and executive PDF summaries.

## Architecture
- Frontend: Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Three.js (interactive live background), motion.
- Backend: FastAPI REST service (Python) orchestrating scanning runs, agent target inventory, and persistence.
- Attack Engine: Modular adversarial testing suite generating deterministic and LLM-assisted exploit payloads.

## REST API Endpoints
- GET /health - Service health check and latency diagnostics.
- GET /api/dashboard/stats - Aggregated security telemetry and vulnerability counts.
- GET /api/agents - Target agent inventory.
- POST /api/agents - Register new agent endpoint for testing.
- POST /api/scans - Initiate adversarial security evaluation.
- GET /api/scans - Scan execution history.
- GET /api/scans/{id} - Detailed status and progress of a specific scan.
- GET /api/scans/{id}/results - Detailed findings, attack payloads, evidence, and remediation guidance.
- GET /api/scans/{id}/report/pdf - Download cryptographically signed executive audit report.
